controls.label: Source constraints
controls.description: Published PDS shape model, including poorly constrained source estimates. Both views use the gray grid for source-flagged poorly constrained regions. Source constraints keeps solid gray for stereo control and blue for limb silhouettes. Grid regions lack those constraints; they are not necessarily wholly unobserved. These are evidence categories, not surface colors. The cartographic north direction follows the long axis at the 2010 encounter, not a spin pole. Hartley 2 tumbles; this display holds an arbitrary rotational phase and does not simulate that motion.

controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: Complete published PDS shape, simplified for display. The gray grid identifies source-flagged poorly constrained regions; solid gray covers stereo-controlled and limb-constrained regions. These are model materials, not observed albedo. Source constraints distinguishes the two better-constrained categories.
